items.description:
Citivet Tamboerskloof is a small-animal veterinary practice on De Lorentz Street that has been part of the Cape Town community for more than 30 years. It offers consultations, emergency care, and on-site x-ray and laboratory facilities within the practice itself, which can speed up diagnosis for pets that need tests done on the day rather than being referred elsewhere.

A second Citivet branch operates in Camps Bay, giving clients in the City Bowl and along the Atlantic seaboard a choice of location for appointments, whether for a routine check-up or an urgent concern about a sick or injured pet. It suits pet owners who want an established, long-serving vet practice with its own diagnostic facilities close to home, rather than travelling further afield for basic tests.

Kenridge Dentists is a general dental practice at Kenridge Business Centre that has served the Durbanville area for more than two decades. Its services span preventative dentistry aimed at helping patients avoid problems before they start, restorative dentistry to repair cavities and damaged or missing teeth, and cosmetic dentistry for an improved smile.

The practice frames its approach as helping patients take the first step towards optimal oral health, with appointments bookable directly through its website. It suits families in Kenridge and the wider Durbanville area who want a full range of dental care, from everyday check-ups to cosmetic work, from one established local practice.

Gary's Surf School is a surf school on Muizenberg's beachfront, established in 1989 and the first surf school in South Africa, with more than 35 years of experience teaching people to surf. Lesson times are set by the tides, and the school backs its teaching with a guarantee: stand up on your first lesson, or get your money back.

The school rents boards and wetsuits for beginners and intermediates, and lessons range from single sessions to multi-day packages with unlimited gear and a dedicated instructor for more personalised coaching. It operates seven days a week, 362 days a year, on Muizenberg beachfront. It suits complete beginners as well as improving surfers looking for coached practice time.

Golden Food Market is a butchery and grocery store on the corner of Civic and Lonedown Roads in Hanover Park, selling fresh and prepacked meat alongside everyday household groceries. The butchery counter stocks beef, chicken and crumbed chicken products such as schnitzels, burgers and steaklets, while the freezer section carries seafood lines including hake, prawns, calamari and snoek, plus frozen vegetables.

The store is a proud stockist of Papa's Joy products, and its grocery aisles cover cooldrinks, oil, flour, sugar, canned foods, spices, cereals, sauces, eggs and household basics. Secure parking is available on site. It suits households in Hanover Park doing a full weekly shop for meat and groceries in one stop.

Healthfort Clinics is a multidisciplinary healthcare practice on Racecourse Road in Milnerton, bringing GP consultations, dentistry, physiotherapy and an onsite blood-testing lab together under one roof. Consultations start from R450, and the practice accepts most South African medical aids, including Discovery, Bonitas and Momentum, as well as cash payments.

The GP practice is open seven days a week with same-day appointments and walk-ins welcome, and a second branch operates in Table View. Services extend to audiology, biokinetics, chiropractic care, dietetics and hair restoration, giving patients access to several specialities without being referred elsewhere. It suits Milnerton and Table View residents who want affordable, accessible healthcare close to home, with or without medical aid.

Hout Bay Family Medical Centre is a general practice on Brighton Street in Hout Bay that has cared for the local community for more than 30 years. The practice describes its approach as compassionate, comprehensive medical care for individuals and families, delivered by an experienced healthcare team.

Care is personalised, preventative and relationship-based, covering everything from routine consultations and everyday health concerns to ongoing family medicine and long-term health management. The practice aims to support every patient's wellbeing over time rather than treating each visit in isolation. It suits families in Hout Bay and the surrounding area who want a GP practice that knows them and their health history well.

Harringtons is a cocktail lounge, restaurant and boutique bar on Harrington Street in Zonnebloem, styled with an air of opulence through polished wooden accents, large windows and velvet bottle-service booths. The venue overlooks the East City's nightlife through panoramic windows and offers grills, light meals and tapas alongside its cocktail menu.

Amenities include a coat check, a dedicated smoking lounge, a boutique DJ booth, and WiFi and A/V equipment for events, and the venue holds an entertainment licence with liquor trading until 4am. Harringtons also runs a regular programme of events, from themed parties to live sessions. It suits a night out that moves from dinner into cocktails, music and dancing in one venue.

Harri's Barber is a retro-styled barbershop on Harrington Street in Zonnebloem, offering barbering, hair styling, beard trims, head shaves and hot towel shaves for men. The shop draws on more than 20 years of barbering experience behind the chair, and the hot towel shave in particular is a classic service that has become harder to find at everyday hairdressers.

Appointments can be booked online ahead of a visit, which helps regulars avoid a long wait for a chair. The shop opens as early as 8am on most weekdays, with a later 10am start on Mondays, fitting in before or after the working day. It suits men in the Zonnebloem and District Six area looking for a classic barbershop experience, from a quick trim to a full hot towel shave and beard tidy-up.

Lotter Attorneys is a law firm on Panorama Road in Panorama, founded in 2007 under the name Warner Attorneys with a focus on women's empowerment and filling a shortage of attorney firms north of Cape Town. The firm offers property law, family law, estates, commercial law, litigation and debt recovery services to the local community.

The practice says it applies equal opportunity based on merit, embracing and advancing historically disadvantaged candidates, and supports procurement from small and medium enterprises in previously disadvantaged communities. It also aims to give young candidate attorneys proper training and development. It suits clients in Panorama and the northern suburbs looking for a locally based firm across a broad range of legal services.

Monk's Chinese is a Chinese takeaway restaurant with branches in the Cape Town CBD and on Durban Road in Mowbray, describing itself as serving the best Chinese food in Cape Town. The menu includes traditional dishes such as smoked noodles and crispy duck, available for takeaway or delivery rather than sit-down dining.

The Mowbray branch delivers to Mowbray itself as well as Observatory, Pinelands, Rosebank, Rondebosch, Claremont and Newlands, while the separate CBD branch on Loop Street covers the city centre, Woodstock, Salt River, Gardens, Vredehoek, Devil's Peak, Green Point, Sea Point and Camps Bay. Orders for either branch can be placed online, by WhatsApp or by phone. It suits households across the southern and inner-city suburbs who want Chinese takeaway delivered without having to leave home.

MoKsh Indian Restaurant at The Paddocks Shopping Centre in Milnerton is a fully licensed restaurant where the chefs prepare authentic cuisine from North India, including clay-oven dishes and curries. It is one of several MoKsh branches across the Western Cape, with other locations in Durbanville, Kenilworth, Paarl, Plattekloof, Plumstead, Somerset West and West Beach.

The Milnerton branch takes reservations for sit-down meals and also caters for private parties, birthdays and corporate functions, giving groups the option of booking the restaurant for a private event rather than a regular table. It suits families looking for child-friendly Indian dining through the week, as well as groups wanting to book a private function built around authentic North Indian food.

Essential Health Pharmacy Clara Anna is a branch of the Essential Health Pharmacy Group, trading from the Clara Anna Fontein retail centre in Durbanville. Alongside its retail pharmacy, the branch runs its own in-house clinic with separate hours for patients who need nursing or wellness services rather than dispensing.

The pharmacy trades Monday to Thursday from 8am to 6pm, Friday until 7pm, Saturday from 8am to 5pm and Sunday from 9am to 2pm, with the same hours on public holidays. The clinic keeps shorter hours across the week, including two Saturdays a month, and is closed on Sundays. It suits Durbanville residents who want pharmacy dispensing and basic clinic services available from the same branch.

Essential Health Pharmacy Strand, on Beach Road in Strand, is one of several branches of the Essential Health Pharmacy Group across the Cape Town area. The branch combines a retail pharmacy with its own in-house clinic, which keeps separate hours for patients who need nursing or wellness services rather than dispensing.

The pharmacy trades Monday to Friday from 8am to 6pm, Saturdays from 8am to 2pm and Sundays from 9am to 1pm, with shorter hours on public holidays. The clinic runs Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm and Saturday mornings, and is closed on Sundays. It suits Strand residents who want pharmacy dispensing and basic clinic services available from the same branch.

Dis-Chem Adelphi is a retail pharmacy and health, beauty and wellness store trading from the Adelphi Centre on Main Road in Sea Point, part of a pharmacy group that has operated in South Africa since 1978. Alongside its dispensary and everyday health and beauty ranges, the Sea Point branch runs its own on-site Clinic and a dedicated Baby Wellness Clinic, giving patients access to nursing and infant health services without needing a referral elsewhere, and it offers Click & Collect for customers who order online and collect in store.

The pharmacy trades seven days a week, staying open later on weekdays than over weekends, while the Clinic and Baby Wellness Clinic keep their own shorter hours, including selected Saturdays, so visitors needing a clinic appointment should check which service they require before arriving. It suits Sea Point residents and visitors who want everyday pharmacy dispensing paired with basic clinical and baby wellness care from the same Main Road branch.
